name: ZCode
description: Provides an Apache-2.0 AI coding workspace from Z.ai with a desktop app, browser UI, and terminal agent CLI that edits files, runs commands, and loads plugins, skills, and MCP servers.

skills.name: Terminal Agent
skills.description: Starts an interactive terminal UI with the `zcode` command for running coding tasks against a local project workspace.

skills.name: Browser Web Mode
skills.description: Serves the ZCode web client and agent locally with `zcode --web`, with optional token auth for LAN access to a workspace.

skills.name: Non-Interactive Prompts
skills.description: Runs a single task non-interactively with the CLI `--prompt` flag, choosing a permission mode such as build or yolo.

skills.name: Plugins and MCP
skills.description: Loads plugins that add skills, commands, and MCP servers, and manages MCP connections with `/mcp` commands in the CLI.
